why: One edit: the slow heartbeat staged on `state/tokens`, the purse each player holds for themselves. A pulse addresses every player standing in its place, so its gate is a fact about the party: a term one player satisfies and another does not would be a beat one body hears and the one beside it does not. Refused at the document, naming the pulse and the datum, with the remedy — name a flag or a `party` datum, or leave `when` out. It declares no unit.
